alpaca_overlap.policy: Instructions were authored for this pilot and are not copied from a known Alpaca export in-repo. Exact string overlap with yahma/alpaca-cleaned is possible and must be reported before scientific claims.

selection_protocol.description: Authored fixed candidate list; exclude Stage-0 smoke instructions; take first 100 unique; Fisher–Yates with LCG seed 20261113; contiguous split discovery[0:50], validation[50:75], held_out[75:100].

stopping_procedure.preflight: Abort before launch if projected high-end cost for the chosen GPU exceeds the authorized spend cap for Stage 1 (set by reviewer).
stopping_procedure.runtime_guard: Enforce a wall-clock deadline covering loads+screening+transfer; checkpoint after each seed; stop if remaining work cannot finish within deadline or remaining budget headroom.
stopping_procedure.early_stop_scientific: If within-model top-k reliability Jaccard < 0.3 at k=10 on discovery folds for every seed, stop before held_out transfer scoring and report instability (feasibility failure).
stopping_procedure.dollars_not_account_limit: Software cost estimates are NOT an enforced Modal account spending limit. Verify actual spend in Modal Billing/Usage.

workload_estimate.explicit_non_claim: This budget deliberately does not reuse the Stage 0 '$0.53 teacher-forced pilot' figure as the full pilot cost. Screening 396 components × 3 seeds dominates and must be counted.
